arStrings.szText: "Adoné—you heard the stories yourself. The Akarat who walked Skovos was a demon."
But Akarat meant something to these people—something real.
Not judgmental against the Player. She's trying to look for the "silver lining" in all this darkness.
My kin, the Askari, are drowning in fear and despair. I had lost sight of hope, and the power that comes with believing in it.
